posts.content_md:
Ed Wesly recently updated is compilation of chemical formulae for holography developers on his site ([http://nlutie.com/ewesly/Formulae/Devel ... meset.html](http://nlutie.com/ewesly/Formulae/Developers/FormulaeFrameset.html)) to include bleaches. Since plagiarism is the sincerest form of flattery, or so I am told, I have greatly flattered Ed by cloning his content over to the holowiki. (Ok, he gave me permission, so it wasn't actually theft.)

I've still got some links fix and some formatting issues to resolve, but the basic content is more than usable at [http://holowiki.nss.rpi.edu/wiki/index. ... c_Formulae](http://holowiki.nss.rpi.edu/wiki/index.php/Ewesly_/_Holographic_Formulae).

Any kudos should be directed to Ed.
